Optional fields:

Command object structure:

- Most bash commands should end with a newline (\n) to cause them to execute

On immediate tasks (e.g., cd, ls, echo, cat) set a duration of 0.1 seconds. On commands (e.g., gcc, find, rustc) set a duration of 1.0 seconds. On slow commands (e.g., make, python3 [long running script], wget [file]) set an appropriate duration as you determine necessary.

Your task is to create a file /app/src/program.cbl in which there will be a new COBOL program in fixed format, 
which will be run from the /app/src directory and should be compiled and executed using GnuCOBOL 3.  
Do not include ">>SOURCE FORMAT IS FIXED". Keep each line ≤ 80 characters. The compiler will use fixed format by default.
The program will run from /app/src directory and must compile with GnuCOBOL 3. File /app/src/INPUT.DAT already exist.
  Processes mortgage applications. Checks terms and generates a payment schedule. The program reads the existing file at /app/src/INPUT.DAT.
  ID - X(10) NAME - X(30) LOAN-AMOUNT - 9(10) PROPERTY-VALUE - 9(10) DOWN-PAYMENT - 9(10) TERM - 9(2) RATE - 9(3)V9(2) separated by the symbol ';'.
  Calculates the minimum down payment (15% of the property value). If the client's down payment is less, the application is rejected.
  For approved applications, the monthly payment is calculated using the annuity nominal formula and a full payment schedule is generated.
  The results are written to the file at /app/data/OUTPUT.DAT: ID - X(10) STATUS - X(5) (REASON - X(50) in case of refusal)
    For rejected applications: ID and reason for rejection.
    For approved applications: ID and  «APPRO\n» and detailed payment schedule:
    MON-NUMBER - 9(3) PAYMENT-AMOUNT, INTEREST-PART, PRINCIPAL-PART - 9(8).99 REMAINING-BALANCE - 9(10).99.(without header).
    - CALCULATIONS: 
        MIN_DOWN = PROP_VALUE * 0.15
        MONTHLY_RATE = INTEREST_RATE / 1200
        MONTHLY_PAYMENT = LOAN_AMOUNT * monthly_rate / (1 - (1 + monthly_rate)**(-term_months))
        Use ROUNDED for all financial computations.

    A correctly constructed payment schedule in the file output. Example output file:
     «TEST000001DENY INSUFFICIENT FUNDS FOR DOWN PAYMENT

      001 00000400.00 00000022.92 00000377.08 0000004622.92 etc.»

FILE-CONTROL.
    SELECT INFILE ASSIGN TO "/app/src/INPUT.DAT"
        ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
    SELECT OUTFILE ASSIGN TO "/app/data/OUTPUT.DAT"
        ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
DATA DIVISION.
FILE SECTION.
FD INFILE.
01 IN-REC PIC X(200).
FD OUTFILE.
01 OUT-REC PIC X(200).
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 WS-EOF PIC X VALUE "N".
   88 END-OF-FILE VALUE "Y".
01 WS-APP-REC.
   05 WS-ID PIC X(10).
   05 WS-NAME PIC X(30).
   05 WS-LOAN-AMT PIC 9(10).
   05 WS-PROP-VALUE PIC 9(10).
   05 WS-DOWN-PMT PIC 9(10).
   05 WS-TERM PIC 9(2).
   05 WS-RATE PIC 9(3)V9(2).
01 MIN-DOWN PIC 9(10).
01 MONTHLY-RATE COMP-2.
01 MONTHLY-PMT COMP-2.
01 INTEREST COMP-2.
01 PRINCIPAL COMP-2.
01 BALANCE COMP-2.
01 MON-NUMBER PIC 9(3) ZERO-FILL.
01 WS-MON-OUT PIC 9(3) ZERO-FILL.
01 WS-PAY-OUT PIC 9(8).99 ZERO-FILL.
01 WS-INT-OUT PIC 9(8).99 ZERO-FILL.
01 WS-PRIN-OUT PIC 9(8).99 ZERO-FILL.
01 WS-BAL-OUT PIC 9(10).99 ZERO-FILL.

    OPEN OUTPUT OUTFILE

            AT END MOVE "Y" TO WS-EOF
        NOT AT END
            PERFORM PROCESS-RECORD
        END-READ
    END-PERFORM
    CLOSE INFILE OUTFILE
    STOP RUN.
PROCESS-RECORD.
    MOVE IN-REC TO TMP-STR
    UNSTRING TMP-STR
        DELIMITED BY ";"
        INTO WS-ID
             WS-NAME
             WS-LOAN-AMT
             WS-PROP-VALUE
             WS-DOWN-PMT
             WS-TERM
             WS-RATE
    END-UNSTRING
    COMPUTE MIN-DOWN = WS-PROP-VALUE * 0.15 ROUNDED
    IF WS-DOWN-PMT < MIN-DOWN
        MOVE WS-ID TO OUT-REC(1:10)
        STRING "DENY" DELIMITED BY SIZE
               " INSUFFICIENT FUNDS FOR DOWN PAYMENT"
               INTO OUT-REC(11:)
        END-STRING
        WRITE OUT-REC
    ELSE
        MOVE WS-ID TO OUT-REC(1:10)
        STRING "APPRO" INTO OUT-REC(11:)
        END-STRING
        WRITE OUT-REC
        COMPUTE MONTHLY-RATE = WS-RATE / 1200 ROUNDED
        COMPUTE MONTHLY-PMT = WS-LOAN-AMT * MONTHLY-RATE /
               (1 - (1 + MONTHLY-RATE) ** (- WS-TERM)) ROUNDED
        MOVE WS-LOAN-AMT TO BALANCE
        PERFORM VARYING MON-NUMBER FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL MON-NUMBER > WS-TERM
            COMPUTE INTEREST = BALANCE * MONTHLY-RATE ROUNDED
            COMPUTE PRINCIPAL = MONTHLY-PMT - INTEREST ROUNDED
            SUBTRACT PRINCIPAL FROM BALANCE ROUNDED
            MOVE MON-NUMBER TO WS-MON-OUT
            MOVE MONTHLY-PMT TO WS-PAY-OUT
            MOVE INTEREST TO WS-INT-OUT
            MOVE PRINCIPAL TO WS-PRIN-OUT
            MOVE BALANCE TO WS-BAL-OUT
            STRING WS-MON-OUT DELIMITED BY SIZE " "
                   WS-PAY-OUT DELIMITED BY SIZE " "
                   WS-INT-OUT DELIMITED BY SIZE " "
                   WS-PRIN-OUT DELIMITED BY SIZE " "
                   WS-BAL-OUT DELIMITED BY SIZE
                   INTO OUT-REC
            END-STRING
            WRITE OUT-REC
        END-PERFORM
    END-IF.
EOF

    },
